fotoswipe.summary: Make room for your best memories.
fotoswipe.description: Review, edit and organize your Photos library, one image at a time.

features.title: Review at your own pace
features.text: Keep what matters and gather what you want to discard. Deletion is requested only after you review and confirm the tray.

features.title: Organize and edit
features.text: Use albums, favorites and image adjustments. When you save an edit in Photos, the original is preserved.

features.title: Your photos, on your device
features.text: Review and comparison are processed locally. FotoSwipe does not send your library to a developer server.
